 Mississippi officials are urging residents to be cautious of scams
 Updated: 10:14 PM CDT Oct 20, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Desmone Mathews Medicare open enrollment has begun, and Mississippi officials are urging residents to be cautious of scams. 
 Insurance Commissioner Mike Chaney said, "Some out-of-state agents may use illegal tactics to sign up customers and collect multiple commissions." 
 Advertisement Chaney recommended working with a Mississippi-licensed agent and carefully reviewing any plan before making changes to coverage. 
 Medicare open enrollment runs through Dec. 7. Open enrollment for Affordable Care Act marketplace plans begins Nov. 1.
